# Page 2^page=2
Earl Bennett is a retired State Geologist and former Dean of the College of Mines and Earth Resources and the College of Science at the University of Idaho. He received his Ph.D. from the University of Idaho (PhD, 1973) and began work with the Idaho Geological Survey at the University of Idaho in 1973. He became the State Geologist in 1989. Not quite a decade later, in 1997, Bennett was appointed Dean of the College of Mines and Earth Resources at UI and the first Dean of the new College of Science established in July 2002. In 2003, he was honored as a life member of the Northwest Mining Association. He retired in 2003 as an Emeritus Professor Bennett currently sits on the boards of the Latah County Historical Society and the Idaho State Historical Society and serves as the Genesee City Historian. The collection includes papers Bennett has written, scans of Genesee newspapers, a self interview performed in 1957 and transcription. There are also reports on the remediation process of the Bunker Hill Superfund Site. Use of the Collection Preferred Citation Author, Description or "Title" of item, date.
